India Calls for Peace and Stable Supply Chains at G20

India has urged the G20 nations to prioritize diplomacy over conflict and to work towards ending wars. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, addressing the G20, also called for the restoration of Black Sea grain exports and the securing of global supply chains. He specifically criticized the weaponization of supply chains.
